parts:
Hi all,

This isn't necessarily the problem of the developers but it seems "processx" package installation continues to be faulty, gleaning from several git threads that don't have a clear resolution. I posted a comment so I'm hoping there will be a further solution, but as of now, I can't install INLA on the HPC system I'm working on. Is there any sort of workaround that would avoid dependency on the "processx" package in the meantime?

Thanks,
Jess
